title: $@, $?, $^ and $<
objective: Print the target name, the out-of-date prerequisites, every prerequisite, and the first prerequisite from one recipe.
hint: $@ is the target being built, $^ is every prerequisite, $< is just the first of them, and $? is the ones that are newer than the target.

steps.description: hey does not exist yet, so nothing is up to date
steps.stdout:
touch one
touch two
target: hey
newer: one two
all: one two
first: one
touch hey

steps.description: the recipe is skipped on the second run
clean removes the target and its prerequisites

lesson.goal: 认识 recipe 中最常用的自动变量。
hints: $@ 是当前目标，$< 是第一个前置条件。
$^ 是全部前置条件，$? 是比目标更新的那些。
自动变量只在 recipe 执行时有意义。
lesson.explanation: 自动变量由 make 根据当前规则上下文填充，不需要手工定义。
